steps.title: Define Project Identity and Architecture
steps.description: Establish basic package metadata under com.studentstudyplanner.app and define target Android SDK 34 specifications with full Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Files
steps.description: Configure app/build.gradle using AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5. Define standard compilation properties and set Java source compatibility configurations.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with standard namespace validation, declare the application launcher, and register local alarm notification receiver permissions.

steps.title: Create SQLite Database Schema
steps.description: Create DatabaseHelper.java to manage tables for study subjects, planner tasks, and academic reminders with robust relational foreign keys.

steps.title: Implement Background Reminder System
steps.description: Create ReminderReceiver.java acting as a BroadcastReceiver to trigger system notifications for scheduled study times using AlarmManager.

steps.title: Design Clean Multi-Tab Planner Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml layout structure containing simple system-level navigation tabs to switch between Dashboard, Subjects, Tasks, and Reminders views.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Navigation Framework
steps.description: Create the MainActivity.java layout switcher logic to alternate active views between different visual modes using traditional click events.

steps.title: Build Dynamic Progress Calculations & Charts
steps.description: Develop math and tracking algorithms inside MainActivity to compute dynamic study statistics, tasks ratios, and visual progress levels.

steps.title: Develop Subjects Management Module
steps.description: Integrate interactive prompts inside the subjects tab to add custom study topics, rendering them dynamically inside list templates.

steps.title: Formulate Tasks Management Logic
steps.description: Establish task item creation workflows complete with subject associations, date selections, checkbox completion flags, and SQLite writebacks.

steps.title: Integrate Scheduler Alert Setup Dialogs
steps.description: Implement notification timing triggers on the Reminders page with simple native Date/Time picker dialogs linking alarms to planned review times.

steps.title: Verify Code Compliance and Clean Memory Leaks
steps.description: Validate safe execution on all resource handles, dynamic database cursor recycling, and standard system style implementation overrides.

steps.title: Building Student Study Planner
steps.description: Trigger local compilation routines using Gradle to generate the production-ready application binary.
